## Description

Visit type (In clinic / Video placeholder until P8), doctor, day strip, available slots (unavailable struck through), optional reason (never shown to reception beyond category), fee and cancellation policy before confirm, confirm → "Booked · confirmation sent"; reschedule/cancel within policy. Uses the same booking path (holds, no double booking).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Portal bookings go through the same concurrency-safe booking service (100-parallel test includes portal channel).
- [ ] **AC2.** Fee and cancellation policy are shown before confirming; late cancellations follow the policy.
- [ ] **AC3.** Free-text reason is stored encrypted and shown only to clinicians.
- [ ] **AC4.** Booking source is recorded (portal) for the ≥ 30 % patient-confirmed metric (exit gate 4).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
